pr_title: Ignore cancellation error when search is cancelled
pr_body:
Since #63520, we will cancel a search that hits shard failures and does not accept partial results. However, that change can return the wrong HTTP code for bad requests (from 4xx to 5xx) due to the cancellation.


Relates #63520
Closes #64012 
Closes #63702
